supply_evidence.title: AfriForum to Oppose Eskom's 8.8% Electricity Tariff Increase ... - Briefly
supply_evidence.snippet: Electricity sales declined by 6.2%, yet Eskom's revenue grew because of successive tariff increases. As prices rise, households and businesses shift to alternative power sources, which further reduces sales volumes and, in turn, prompts the utility to apply for yet another increase.

supply_evidence.title: Afriforum challenges Eskom's 8.83% electricity price increase
supply_evidence.snippet: Civil rights group Afriforum said it would formally oppose Eskom's application to raise South Africa's average electricity tariff by 8.83% for the 2027/28 year.

supply_evidence.title: AfriForum Halts Eskom and Nersa Deal - energynews.africa
supply_evidence.snippet: AfriForum secures a temporary halt on Eskom's R54 billion settlement with Nersa. The dispute stems from an alleged lack of public engagement and opaque decision-making. The deal allows Eskom to raise power tariffs by 8.76% and 8.83% in 2026 and 2027.
